full_judgment: 5. Police submitted charge-sheet on 9.6.93 against the two First Information Report named accused persons namely, Faruque and Alamgir, but did not send up the petitioners and others in the charge-sheet, On the same date the informant filed a naraji petition before the learned Magistrate and prayed to take cognizance against 9 accused persons who had not been sent up in the charge-sheet. The naraji petition was heard by the learned Magistrate on 26.6.93 and the learned Magistrate took cognizance against 21 persons including the two First Information Report named accused persons and the present petitioners and some others under sections 143/342/304 of the Penal Code.
